action.objective: Verify the reserved candidate f2g1 at full depth, checking king safety and tactics, to see if it becomes commit-ready or reveals a better plan.
action.rationale: The broad depth-3 search suggested f2g1 (score 736, exact) among top candidates, keeping the king centralized on g1 rather than returning toward the c4 rook's file. However Black's last move c6c4 pressures the king area and the g4/h4 pawns, so I must verify king safety and tactical refutations for this king move before considering commit. This single-candidate verification uses the reserved 2000 nodes at target depth 4.
